_readme: Written by scripts/gen-concept-cars.py; read by the asset gallery.

models.name: concept-buggy
models.note: RC off-road buggy: cab-forward shell, roll cage, open engine, big wing, coil-over shocks and knobby tyres.

models.name: concept-rally
models.note: Rally hatch: boxy shell, flared arches, light pod on the bumper, roof scoop and spoiler, mud flaps, door roundels.

models.name: concept-gt
models.note: Le Mans GT: long low wedge, tinted bubble cockpit over fender humps, shark fin into a full-width wing, splitter and diffuser, roundels.

models.name: concept-pip
models.note: Bubble micro car: short rounded shell, glass bubble with a painted cap, frog-eye lamps, chrome bumper hoops and a spare wheel on the tail.

models.name: dash-plus
models.note: Dash with a touch more: lamps and grille, a bonnet scoop, side and rear glass, mirrors, pod intakes, tail lamps and twin pipes.

models.name: bolt-plus
models.note: Bolt with a touch more: wing endplates fore and aft, suspension arms, an open cockpit with a screen, mirrors on stalks, intakes, a nose roundel, exhausts under the wing and a rain light on its pylon.

models.name: carve-plus
models.note: Carve with a touch more: twin round lamps, bonnet louvres, wing endplates and gurney, canards, diffuser, side and rear glass.

models.name: rumble-plus
models.note: Rumble with a touch more: chrome radiator, lamps on stalks, bonnet straps and louvres, a side exhaust, an open cockpit with a headrest fairing, a fuel cap, tail roundels and a tail lamp.
